{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicates.sum()}")

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count()}")

# Show the highest sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient (first 5):\n{max_sample_seq.head(5)}")

# Confirm the data dictionary instruction: keep highest sample_seq
# Create a deduplicated DataFrame
# The data dictionary says: "The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient."
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print(f"Deduplicated DataFrame shape: {df_dedup.shape}")

# Check if any patient_id remains in the deduplicated set
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count after dedup: {df_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")"}
